versions.content: Service Name CanIf_SetPduMode Syntax Std_ReturnType CanIf_SetPduMode ( uint8 ControllerId, CanIf_PduModeType PduModeRequest ) Service ID [hex] 0x09 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant ControllerId All PDUs of the own ECU connected to the corresponding CanIf ControllerId, which is assigned to a physical CAN controller are addressed. Parameters (in) PduModeRequest Requested PDU mode change Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Request for mode transition has been accepted. E_NOT_OK: Request for mode transition has not been accepted. Description This service sets the requested mode at the L-PDUs of a predefined logical PDU channel. Available via CanIf.h
